protocol.title: A Solvent Replenishment Solution for Managing Evaporation of Biochemical Reactions in Air-Matrix Digital Microfluidics Devices
protocol.source: Lab on a Chip, 2015 (Sandia National Laboratories, SAND2015-0066J)
protocol.platform: Air-matrix digital microfluidics (DMF) on six-layer printed circuit board (PCB)
protocol.objective: Demonstrate just-in-time solvent replenishment as an evaporation management strategy enabling DMF-mediated biochemical reactions (RNA fragmentation, first-strand cDNA synthesis, PCR) over a wide temperature range (4-95 C) and incubation times up to 1 h without oil matrix or humidified chamber

device.substrate: Six-layer printed circuit board (PCB); multilayer copper electrodes plated with nickel (185 um) and gold (3.6 um); fabricated by photolithography and etching
device.hydrophobic_coating: Teflon-AF 50 nm (1% wt/wt in Fluorinert FC-40, 1500 rpm 30 s, baked 100 C 5 h); applied to both top and bottom plates
device.top_plate: Glass substrate coated with unpatterned indium tin oxide (ITO) + 50 nm Teflon-AF
device.bottom_plate: PCB with 100 actuation electrodes (1.6 x 1.6 mm each) and 6 reservoir electrodes (3.5 x 5.5 mm each) plus 1 waste reservoir (5.2 x 5.5 mm)

thermal_zones.isolation: Thermal voids (1.0 x 7.0 mm) machined into PCB substrate between zones
thermal_zones.notes: RTD measurement on back side offset from droplet temperature by 3 C (+/- 0.5 C); compensation factor programmed into zone settings

thermal_modules.attachment: Thermally conductive epoxy to gold-plated copper pads on back side; thermally coupled to front-side thermal zone electrodes via drilled through holes filled with conductive epoxy
thermal_modules.controller: Custom control board with PICAXE 14M2 microcontroller (PWM + polarity control for heating and cooling)

through_hole.pump: Stepper motor with computer-controlled electronic interface (Allmotion) responding to ASCII commands
through_hole.purpose: Introduction of replenishing droplets from external syringe pump reservoir onto DMF device surface

actuation.signal_source: Function generator (Trek, Medina NY) amplified by Digi-Key amplifier

thermal_imaging.camera: ThermoProTM TP8 thermographic IR camera (Guide Infrared)

shared.NucleaseFreeWater: Nuclease-free distilled water (molecular biology grade); used as replenishing solvent in all three protocols
shared.PluronicF127: Pluronic F-127 (Sigma Chemical), 0.1% w/v in master mix (cDNA protocol only)

RNA_fragmentation.RNA_PBMC: Human peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) total RNA; extracted with RNAzol + Direct-zol kit (Zymo Research); 380 ng/uL; stored at -80 C
RNA_fragmentation.FragmentationBuffer: 10X NEBNext RNA fragmentation buffer (New England Biolabs)
RNA_fragmentation.RNA_source: 5-10 x 10^6 PBMC cells centrifuged 1000 rpm 4 C 5 min, resuspended 1 mL RNAzol, diluted 400 uL water, 15 min RT incubation, 16000 rpm 4 C 15 min; aqueous phase 1:1 ethanol; Direct-zol kit purification; eluted 10 uL water
RNA_fragmentation.RNA_QC: Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with RNA Nano 6000 Chip

cDNA_synthesis.RNA_PBMC: Pre-fragmented human PBMC total RNA, 100 ng per 0.5 uL droplet
cDNA_synthesis.purification: AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter Genomics), 1.8X volumes, eluted 10-20 uL nuclease-free water
cDNA_synthesis.QC_bioanalyzer: Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with High Sensitivity DNA Assay Chip

PCR.PCRMasterMix: Hot Start Taq 2X Master Mix (NEB) supplemented with 0.025 U/uL additional Hot Start Taq (NEB) to double Taq concentration

PCRPrimers.preparation: Equimolar mix; 4X stock at 4 uM per primer in nuclease-free water

PCR.M13mp18_Template: Single-stranded genomic DNA from bacteriophage M13mp18 (NEB); diluted to 250 pg/uL in nuclease-free water
PCR.QC: Gel electrophoresis on 2% agarose E-Gel system (Life Technologies); expected band at 200 bp

evaporation_management.strategy: Just-in-time solvent replenishment: pre-heated 0.5 uL droplets of nuclease-free water dispensed via through-hole syringe interface, transported to thermal zone edge, pre-heated 5 s, then merged with reaction droplet to restore volume
evaporation_management.replenishment_trigger: When reaction droplet volume decreases by 15-20% (monitored visually in current device)
evaporation_management.delivery_mechanism: PEEK tube through-hole + stepper-motor-driven syringe pump
evaporation_management.future_direction: Automatic volume/concentration sensing with feedback control for autonomous replenishment

PCR_total.schedule: 1 droplet per cycle after 95 C denaturation step

steps.name: Dispense RNA and fragmentation buffer
steps.notes: Three independent 0.5 uL RNA droplets dispensed separately; fragmentation buffer dispensed from its own reservoir

steps.name: Merge RNA droplets and fragmentation buffer
steps.notes: Final 2 uL reaction droplet transported to thermal zone

steps.name: Thermal fragmentation
steps.notes: Without replenishment, reaction droplet dries completely in <2 min at 94 C

steps.name: Evaporation replenishment (6 water droplets)
steps.notes: Each water droplet pre-heated 5 s at thermal zone edge before merging; restores volume to <=20% variation

steps.name: Cool to 4 C and add stop solution
steps.notes: Droplet shuttled to 4 C thermal zone; stop solution terminates RNA fragmentation

steps.name: QC detection
steps.expected_result: Fragments 40-1000 nt, peak ~150 nt; no residual 18S (1868 nt) or 28S (5025 nt) rRNA peaks
steps.off_chip_QC: Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer RNA Nano 6000 Chip; Zymo RNA Clean and Concentrator-5 purification before analysis, eluted 5 uL nuclease-free water

steps.name: Dispense fragmented RNA and primer PP_RT
steps.notes: Step A of Peregrine first-strand cDNA synthesis method

steps.name: Denaturation at 65 C then cool to 4 C
steps.notes: Droplet shuttled between thermal zones for rapid temperature change

steps.name: Merge master mix (3 droplets) and incubate
steps.operation: dispense + mix (sequential merge) then heat x2

steps.name: Merge primer PP_TS and extend at 42 C for 60 min
steps.notes: Step C of Peregrine method; SMARTScribe RT template-switching and extension; majority of replenishment events occur here

steps.name: Termination at 70 C for 5 min
steps.notes: Step D of Peregrine method; inactivates SMARTScribe RT

steps.name: QC detection
steps.expected_result: Ct comparable to conventional benchscale (p=0.14, unpaired two-tailed t-test, N=3); ds-cDNA size distribution and yield indistinguishable from conventional method
steps.off_chip_QC: qPCR Ct assay (CFX96, Bio-Rad) + Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Assay Chip

steps.name: Dispense and merge PCR reagents
inputs: PCRMasterMix (0.5 uL; Hot Start Taq 2X MM + doubled Taq at 0.025 U/uL)
PCRPrimers (0.5 uL; 4 uM per primer, equimolar mix, 4X stock)

steps.name: 33 PCR cycles with per-cycle evaporation replenishment
steps.operation: heat x3 + dispense + mix per cycle; 33 cycles unrolled

replenishment_per_cycle.timing: After 95 C denaturation step, before annealing

steps.bioscript_note: BioScript has no loop construct; all 33 cycles unrolled as sequential heat/dispense/mix blocks

steps.name: Final extension
steps.purpose: Completion of all partially extended amplicons

steps.name: QC detection
steps.expected_result: Single band at 200 bp on gel; comparable to conventional PCR though with slightly reduced yield
steps.off_chip_QC: 2% agarose gel electrophoresis (E-Gel system, Life Technologies)

RNA_fragmentation.control_size_profile: Broad distribution; prominent peaks at ~1900 nt (18S rRNA) and >=4000 nt (28S rRNA)
RNA_fragmentation.DMF_fragment_size: Predominantly 40-1000 nt, peak ~150 nt; no residual rRNA peaks
RNA_fragmentation.conclusion: DMF evaporation management enables equivalent RNA fragmentation to benchscale

cDNA_synthesis.DMF_Ct_vs_conventional: Comparable (p=0.14, N=3, unpaired two-tailed t-test, unequal variances)
cDNA_synthesis.ds_cDNA_yield: Equivalent to conventionally prepared first-strand cDNA
cDNA_synthesis.conclusion: DMF Peregrine cDNA synthesis yields equivalent product quality to benchscale

PCR.band_presence: Correct 200 bp band confirmed by gel electrophoresis
PCR.conclusion: DMF PCR with evaporation management produces correct amplicon; minor yield reduction acceptable

evaporation_management.conclusion: Just-in-time replenishment maintains reaction volume and temperature within acceptable bounds across all three protocols
